# Instagram Mentions Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/instagram-tagged-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-tagged-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.588**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract data from tagged posts and mentions on Instagram. Just add one or more Instagram usernames and get post text, hashtags, mentions, comments, images, likes, locations, and metadata. Export scraped data, run the scraper via API, schedule and monitor runs, or integrate with other tools.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Post $0.0027 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-tagged-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-instagram-tagged-scraper@0.0.588#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      username: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | array | yes |  | Instagram username — Just insert a username or URL of the profile you want to get the user tagged user tagged posts from. |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | Maximum user tagged posts per profile — Maximum number of user tagged posts you want to scrape per profile. If you set it to 5, you'll get 5 user tagged posts for each profile you've included. |
